description: Different model profiles should preserve project-aware plan item identity and unsupported project reporting for a polyglot repository.

lockedFields.reason: Project planning must preserve partial audit coverage from the project-audits artifact.
The experimental Kotlin project and supported web project each contribute one plan item in this fixture.
The Kotlin calculator and web session client are both untested candidates that become add-test items.
Flattened plan items must preserve their owning project root.
Project item IDs are the stable cross-project reference for future generation.
The candidate remains an add-test action until test evidence changes.
Project plan artifacts must retain the repo-native verification command for the owning project.
Unsupported roots must remain visible in project planning output.
